title: ENTRY live monitoring as the demotion signal (not an edge lever): live ENTRY closes vs the dev/held-out band, rule written before use
note: RULE (written before the first live read, operator 2026-11-01: ENTRY goes live on bybit_2 as approved). Expected band from dev/held-out: traded-5 -0.041 net R per decision (dev, 4 seeds, n about 5.5k each); pooled frozen-60 +0.007 (dev and held-out); October 2026 -0.019R (manager). Evaluate realised net R per closed ENTRY decision (full cost stack: fees, slippage, funding) per account over ALL its closed ENTRY trades, every 50 closes once n >= 100. FLAG ENTRY_LIVE_NEGATIVE when mean + 2*SE < 0 (SE = SD/sqrt(n)): the live loss is statistically real. FLAG ENTRY_LIVE_BELOW_DEV when mean < -0.041 - 2*SE: worse than even the weak traded-5 dev reading. A flag is a realtime ping to the operator with the numbers; it demotes nothing by itself (no halting; a demotion is the mirror-window rule's, and the operator's). Reads only closed trades; sizes nothing. Tier 2 because it adds a standing read on the live ENTRY legs. Gates this adds: none (a flag, not a switch). [2026-11-04 lane ML-ENTRY-RETRAIN-MONITOR] BUILT report-only: src/runtime/ml_entry_live_monitor.py implements the rule exactly as written (n>=100, checkpoint every 50 closes, mean+2SE<0 => ENTRY_LIVE_NEGATIVE, mean<-0.041-2SE => ENTRY_LIVE_BELOW_DEV, sample SD, per account over all closed strategy_name=ml_entry rows, net R via net_r_label.net_r_for_trade = gross - taker - maker - funding over SL-distance risk). Operational exit reasons (the NOT_STRATEGY_EXIT vocabulary incl. operator_flatten_reconciled, so bybit_2 6844/6845 drop out) are excluded and counted; R-uncomputable and uncosted rows are counted, never zeroed. Hourly tick in src/main.py (best-effort, no broker call), ping via the losing_streak shape, read surface /api/diag/log_file?name=ml_entry_live_monitor_state, brief_line() for the brief. A flag halts/demotes/sizes nothing. 14 tests incl. exact-threshold, checkpoint idempotence, vocabulary equality with real_money_close_attribution. NOT verified: the live journal (no access from this sandbox); strategy_name='ml_entry' is the value strategies.yaml and soak_state use, confirm on the first read. FIRST OBSERVATION: after deploy, /api/diag/log_file?name=ml_entry_live_monitor_state shows __last_check__ newer than the trader start and bybit_2 {n, state}; the first VERDICT is the first checkpoint at n=100 graded closes on an account (insufficient_n until then is 'no verdict', not a pass).
